title: BUG: 402.2 / 383.3 — the trigger's target is chosen while FINALIZING the trigger (before anyone receives Priority); engine defers the choice to resolution

repro.testName: BUG: 402.2 / 383.3 — the trigger's target is chosen while FINALIZING the trigger (before anyone receives Priority); engine defers the choice to resolution

history.note: rule-correct fix (lock targets for ALL triggers at finalization, not just die-triggers) makes the BUG test pass but breaks ~60 card tests written to the engine's resolution-time convention (Adaptatron, Pickpocket, Card Sharp, Leona, Tideturner, ...); no narrower gate exists since play-self is exactly the broad case. Needs a coordinated migration, reverted.
